edge_explainer: CONFIRMATION COURT, independent re-derivation from EDGAR/XBRL and the filed 8-K exhibits. Nothing inherited from the batch. CARRY MATH VERIFIED WITH A HAIRCUT: T-Mobile's 'Adjusted Free Cash Flow' is defined in the Q2-2026 release as net cash from operating activities LESS cash purchases of property and equipment - no add-backs of any kind, and it INCLUDES the UScellular merger cash costs. Tied to the dollar across six quarters (Q2-26: 7,500-2,703=4,797; H1-26: 14,722-5,326=9,396). The old securitization add-back that inflated the metric ~22% (FY2024 guidance table added back $3.4-4.0B of beneficial-interest proceeds) is GONE and its removal was footnoted honestly. So the ~9.8% yield is NOT an adjusted-metric artifact - at the live 172.94 x 1,072.7M shares = $185.5B cap it is 10.03% on the $18.6B guide midpoint. BUT the metric excludes three real recurring cash costs: spectrum ($3.47B FY24 / $2.57B FY25, ~$2.28B 3-yr normalized), finance-lease principal (~$1.33B/yr, sits in financing), and now fiber-JV equity calls. Owner FCF ~= $14.3B => 7.70%. The headline overstates distributable owner cash by ~230bp. On the SAME definition (FY25 audited OCF-capex over live cap) TMUS yields 9.70% vs VZ 10.58% vs T 12.38% - the LOWEST of the big three. FAIRNESS SHOWN, NOT ASSERTED: forward EV/Core-Adj-EBITDA at the last five year-ends = 8.15/8.34/8.31/9.66/8.25x (net debt reconstructed as LongTermDebt+FinanceLeaseLiability-Cash and validated EXACTLY against the company's own factbook: 12/31/25 $82.95B vs company $82,954M; 6/30/26 $84.09B vs $84,095M). Today 7.23x = 11.3% BELOW the 5-year low; trailing 7.51x vs a 9.07-10.32x band. The band is broken through, not merely touched. The market is paying ZERO for a +10% EBITDA grower vs VZ/T at 2-3%. TAILS NOT BOUNDED - three compounding items the batch court did not have. (1) DISCLOSURE NARROWING, the decisive finding: postpaid PHONE net adds, postpaid PHONE churn, total postpaid net CUSTOMER adds, broadband/HSI net adds and prepaid metrics were ALL present in the Q4-2025 release (2026-02-11: 962k phone net adds, 1.02% phone churn, 2.4M customer adds) and ALL absent from Q1-2026 (2026-04-28) and Q2-2026. 'High Speed' appears 0 times in the Q2-2026 release AND in the full filed Investor Factbook, whose table of contents now reads 'Account Metrics' where a Customer Metrics section used to be. There is NO announced methodology change - zero instances of 'no longer', 'beginning in 2026', 'changed', 'revised' or 'metric' in the release that dropped them, under the headline 'Accelerating Account Growth'. This clears the elevate boundary because the datum is not de-emphasized, it is unavailable - and phone churn is exactly the series that would register satellite substitution or cable-MVNO share loss. (2) STARLINK/SPACEX TERMINAL TAIL, unbounded and live: SpaceX bought EchoStar spectrum (~$17B, Sep-2025 - which dates the 52w high), FCC approved May-2026, TMUS/T/VZ agreed in principle to a three-way spectrum-pooling JV 'to help satellite providers reach more customers' (10-Q Note 3, 2026-05-14), the 52w low of 165.66 was set 2026-06-30 on Starlink-mobile fears, Bernstein cut the whole complex 2026-07-14, the CEO publicly refused an expanded Starlink deal on the 07-23 call, and SpaceX's first earnings report TODAY (2026-08-05) targeting global direct-to-device by 2028 took TMUS -2.4%. TMUS is -14.4% YTD while VZ is +16.1% - a 30-point intra-sector divergence that refutes the batch's single-print framing. (3) FIBER JV CAPEX RISING BELOW THE METRIC LINE: capex guide unchanged at ~$10.0B, but 10-Q Note 3 discloses ~$700M (i3 Broadband, closing H2-2026) and ~$2.0B (GoNetspeed/Greenlight, H1-2027) of 50% JV equity calls that land in 'Investments in unconsolidated affiliates' - inside investing, BELOW Adjusted FCF, invisible to both guides. ~$2.7B over four quarters = ~15% of a year's Adjusted FCF. That is the masking channel of the name. BATCH'S TOP UNVERIFIABLE NOW RESOLVED: factbook footnotes quantify the acquired accounts (Q3-2025 +1,448,000 UScellular and +633,000 Metronet/other = 2,081k). Postpaid accounts 31,502k->34,700k = +3,198k, of which organic net adds 1,171k and acquired 2,081k less 34k base adjustments. So ~65% of the account growth is ACQUIRED, ~35% organic, and the '+13% industry-leading postpaid service revenue growth' headlined throughout the release is roughly 5-6% ORGANIC. Still industry-leading (VZ/T grow 2-3%) but about half the marketed magnitude, and never split. Forward consequence is arithmetic, not forecast: from the 2026-10-22 print the acquired contribution anniversaries and reported growth resets to ~5-7%. CLEAN ITEMS, stated for balance: definition honesty (the metric got cleaner, not dirtier, and the Nov-2024 reclassification was footnoted); receivable-sale programs FLAT not scaled (EIP $1.3B and Service $775M identical at 6/30/26 and 12/31/25, so OCF is not being pumped); regulatory genuinely small (no DOJ, residual 2021-cyberattack FCC inquiries immaterial, Auction 113 only $278M); DT verified at 53.86% from the dividend split ($593M of $1,101M in Q2) with no selldown evidence and buyback absorption a non-issue; leverage 2.34x net debt/LTM Core Adj EBITDA with $6.1B of short-term debt to refinance and a $2.0B undrawn CP program. But interest expense is +14.4% YoY ($922M->$1,055M/qtr, ~4.9% avg cost rising as 3.15-3.90% notes roll), which is the arithmetic behind Core Adj EBITDA +10% converting to Adjusted FCF of only +3.4% - the cash line compounds at ~3%.
